ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A thousand buddhas is the large inherited company invoked as past, present, or future awakened figures.
EvidenceBody: Baohua Xian places this immense company against the response demanded in his own hall; Yuansou Xingduan invokes it in an imperial-birthday assembly, and Yongming Yanshou treats it as a canonical multitude. These scenes establish a collective, not one person named “Thousand Buddhas.”
